summary: Phase 4 (Admin Rules) implementation plan: engine changes to make items rule-driven, Firestore data model for calculationRules/profileSystems/auditLogs, Cloud Functions for rule lifecycle with audit, admin UI (rule list, editor, live sandbox, version history), app-side rules sync with offline fallback, pinned versions + recalculate banner, tests and verification. Incorporates user decisions: single-step approval, test-matrix conflict detection, tablet/web-optimized admin UI, pinned rule versions with recalculate.
